mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) signals rising inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 105), a decline in industrial production indicates a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 850.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS (indicating an active monetary tightening cycle) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (RSAFS > 370000), a decline in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 370000 and RSAFS declines.
